svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Healthcare expenditure per capita is measured in current international-$, which adjusts for price differences
between countries. Under-five mortality is the share of newborns who die before reaching the age of five.
Current health expenditure per capita, PPP (current international $; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Child mortality (deaths per 100 live births; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: United Nations Inter-agency Group for Child Mortality Estimation (2025); Global Health Expenditure Database, WHO, via World
Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
